_readme.purpose: Single source of mock API data for local UI testing. Every API call in the app is commented out and reads from here via MockData.get('<dot.path>').
_readme.shape: Each leaf is the exact response body the matching endpoint used to return, so controller parsing is unchanged.
_readme.dates: Visit/message timestamps sit around 2026-09-17. Screens that filter by a picked date ignore it here — the same payload is returned for every date.
_readme.login: Any email + any password signs in as Jordan Avery (role Clinical, status Completed), which is what HomeScreen requires.
_readme.media: Avatar and chat-image URLs point at real public hosts (pravatar.cc, picsum.photos), so images render with an internet connection. Document URLs are example.com placeholders: the in-app PDF preview (pages/profile/widgets/pdf_viewer.dart) fetches a URL directly rather than through the API layer, so it will show its error state. Point those DocumentUrl values at a reachable PDF to exercise that screen.
_readme.adding: Add a key here, then read it at the call site with mockResponse(MockData.get('<section>.<key>')). Keep the body shaped like the real response — the controllers parse it unchanged.
